What Does The Name Afwan Mean?
s: As a name, Afwān/Afwān (often transliterated Afwan, ‘Affan, or A’fan depending on regional orthography) carries the sense of “one who forgives,” “absolution,” or “grace,” and it resonates with the Quranic attribute al-‘Afūw (The Pardoning).
